title: Paycheck Comparison
description: Compare two job offers: salary, bonus, benefits value, PTO and estimated tax.
howto: Fill in Offer A: salary, bonus, benefits, PTO days, and estimated tax rate.
Fill in Offer B the same way.
Compare the side-by-side table of cash, benefits, and total value.
Read the verdict showing which offer has the higher estimated total value.

faqs.a: Each PTO day is valued at salary divided by 260 working days, a common approximation.

faqs.q: What tax rate should I enter?
faqs.a: Enter your estimated effective tax rate on cash compensation. It is only an estimate; actual tax depends on your full situation.

faqs.q: Does it include cost of living?
faqs.a: No. It compares compensation only. A lower offer in a cheaper city can still leave you better off.
